name: Mpox
summary: Clade Ib mpox has community transmission in nine European countries; South Africa reports 26 cases in 2026
state: WHO's situation report of 14 Sep records community transmission of clade Ib in nine European countries, including the UK, France, Germany and Italy, and notes standing recommendations extended to August 2027 (WHO). South Africa's health department reported 26 confirmed cases in 2026 to 27 Oct, 19 of them clade Ib and 20 detected since August (Daily Maverick, 3 Nov). Searches to 13 Nov found no new emergency of international concern, so clade I spread outside Africa keeps this at Watch.
for_you: Risk to the general public in the UK remains low. People at higher risk can check UKHSA and NHS guidance on mpox symptoms and vaccine eligibility; travellers can check FCDO travel health advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: clade Ib community transmission outside Africa (nine European countries, WHO 14 Sep); no PHEIC in effect

sources.title: WHO — Multi-country outbreak of mpox, external situation report 69
Daily Maverick — Mpox vaccine stock will be deployed as needed as cases climb to 26

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.

rubric.alert: PHEIC in effect with accelerating growth.
rubric.watch: Clade I spreading outside Africa or a regional surge.
